calls.head: Something has to give
calls.body: The Ducks are near the top of the league for shot volume, and the Panthers are one of the league’s best at keeping shots away. We’ll side with the Ducks.
calls.call: The Ducks take more than the league-average 56.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 against the Panthers.
calls.nums: Anaheim 6th for shot volume (61.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Florida 2nd for keeping shots away
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On 5-on-5 shot attempts, Anaheim had 39.7 per 60. The league average is 56.4 per 60, and they came in at 61.4 per 60.

calls.head: The Panthers shut down the dangerous stuff; the Ducks don’t
calls.body: The Panthers are one of the league’s best for preventing dangerous shots, at the sheltered end; the Ducks are near the bottom of the league, at the exposed end. Expect that gap to show.
calls.call: The Panthers prevent dangerous shots better than the Ducks do.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: On how dangerous the average shot allowed was, Florida had 4.5% a shot and Anaheim 6.0% a shot. Coming in, Florida was at 6.0% a shot and Anaheim at 6.5% a shot.
calls.usual: FLA 6.0% a shot · ANA 6.5% a shot
calls.tonight: FLA 4.5% a shot · ANA 6.0% a shot
calls.beyond: Anaheim’s shots at 5-on-5 were less dangerous than usual: a 4.5% chance of scoring on the average shot, against their usual 6.4% (league average 6.3%). A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

ANA.head: We had this close to even (59% for Anaheim), and Anaheim came through.

FLA.head: We had this close to even (41% for Florida), and it went Anaheim’s way.

surprises.head: Anaheim won against the run of play
surprises.body: Played out 100 times with these chances, Florida wins 82. Anaheim won anyway.

story.head: Dostal steals one
paras: Cutter Gauthier scored twice, opening the scoring late in the first. Twice the Panthers answered a Ducks lead. Mikael Granlund won it in overtime.
The Panthers had the better of the play. Replay the chances a hundred times and the Panthers win about four in five. Lukas Dostal made the difference in net, stopping 29 of 31.

items.text: One of the preview’s two calls held.
